input.policy:
[[rule]]
server = "filesystem"
tool = "write_file"
args = { path = "~/projects/*" }
decision = "allow"

[[rule]]
tool = "*delete*"
decision = "deny"
reason = "nothing gets deleted by an agent"

[[rule]]
client = "claude-code"
server = "llm"
tool = "Bash"
decision = "ask"

[[rule]]
tool = "send_*"
decision = "ask"
redact = ["token"]
